description: One Table API serves Azure Storage tables (`*.table.core.windows.net`) and Azure Cosmos DB for Table (`*.table.cosmos.azure.com`). The spec names only the Storage audience; a Cosmos DB endpoint takes Microsoft Entra ID tokens for `https://cosmos.azure.com` (Microsoft Learn: "Use data plane role-based access control with Azure Cosmos DB for Table"). Default to the Cosmos audience and keep the Storage audience for Storage endpoints. OData JSON wants its metadata level named in `Accept`; minimal metadata is the service default (Table service REST API: "Payload format for Table service operations").
